source_doubts.where: Theorem thm:input (cited from the characteristic-two companion)
source_doubts.quote: There exist a finite field $K_2$ of characteristic two, a finitely generated group $H_2$, and finite sums $a_2,b_2\in K_2[H_2]$ with $a_2b_2=1$ and $b_2a_2\ne1$.
source_doubts.problem: The whole counterexample rests on this external claim, which would refute Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture (an open problem). The source neither proves it nor gives an explicit checkable instance, so the main theorem is established only conditionally on it.

unverified_marks.where: Box right after Theorem thm:input in Section 1
unverified_marks.concern: The cited input is not proved or checked; it would contradict Kaplansky's direct-finiteness conjecture, so the text proves only the implication 'Theorem thm:input implies Theorem thm:main'.
